name: Kempinski Hotel Riga
positioning: Grand Hotel Kempinski Riga, a luxury hotel in the heart of Riga's Old Town with Amber Restaurant and the Stage22 Bar & Restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in Riga's Old Town
Guests who like a hotel restaurant and a rooftop bar and restaurant on site

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Riga's Old Town.
The hotel offers both rooms and suites.
The hotel has a restaurant called Amber Restaurant.
The hotel has a Business Package for business stays in Riga.

highlights.text: Stage22 Bar & Restaurant has a rooftop.
The hotel offers a Spa Package that includes a bespoke massage.
Amber Restaurant is one of the hotel's restaurants, alongside Stage22 Bar & Restaurant.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes that parking may be limited at this historic building.
